title: Entropia
description: Three women, three lives in parallel worlds, until the moment a fly causes a bug in the system. The universe collapses, sex is in the air, bras are overrated and the stars twinkle!
music: Gergely Matos A dead body becomes stuck by a riverbank. Its decaying insides still hide a human soul – a miniature of the deceased. Rotting organs part and a tiny creature gets out. Standing on the river bank
it says goodbye to the corpse and sets off on a journey through the post-mortem land.
